items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewee only responds to a story about Frank Duesen and a horn, mentioning 'Gable's horn' as a reference point for quality/cost. No personal interaction or relationship between the interviewee and Gable is described.

ctx.x: Frankie Duesen told me at the time they played at the old Paris Prism and he was playing the valve I believe, I don't know if it was valve or slide, I don't know what it was, but anyway, one of them keepers broke his horn, or somebody broke his horn. Broke Frank his horn, yeah. Yeah. So he said, I'm sorry, I don't worry about it, I'll buy you another. So Frank was kind of glad, you know. So he made him go to the oil lines, or glue walls, I believe it was. And the old man that was the clerk there, and his man met…
That's why he's got a Gable.
